execution.connection_guidance: Verify that the provider responds at `{base_url}` and that the model `{model}` is available. If the server is running, check the logs to see if the connection was closed during a long request.
execution.general_guidance: The server may still be running: check the technical cause and request logs before restarting it.
core.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS API URL without credentials, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1.
core.unreachable: Core is unreachable. Check the address and whether the server is running.
core.access_denied: Access denied. Check the Core management credential and address.
core.request_rejected: Core did not accept this request.
core.incompatible_response: Core returned an incompatible management response.
core.incompatible_protocol: Core uses an incompatible management protocol.
core.manual_connection: Inference endpoint is reachable. Manage its models on the server.
core.no_chat_model: The inference endpoint has no chat model. Load one on the server and retry.
core.model_discovery_failed: Could not discover a chat model at this address.
